inlines.v: OPENLY, adverb o'pnly. 1. Publicly; not in private; without secrecy; as, to avow our sins and follies openly How grossly and openly do many of us contradict the precepts of the gospel by our ungodliness and worldly lusts! 2. Plainly; evidently; without reserve or disguise.
